abstract: This study extends the Ricardian framework to forestry by accounting for tree growth and harvest dynamics. Indeed, whereas standard Ricardian applications in agriculture assume that farmland prices reflect a perpetual flow of annual profits from the most climate-adapted crops, forestland prices additionally capitalize the age-dependent value of standing timber accumulated over decades. Coupling the Ricardian and Faustmann approaches, we theoretically show that this age dependence is systematically tied to species (and therefore to climate), so that stand age becomes a confounding factor in standard pooled Ricardian regressions. Our theory implies a correction – the age-structured Ricardian approach – that regresses the climate-value relationship across stand-age classes, with the coefficients obtained for the youngest class providing the closest approximation to the true Ricardian effects in the context of forestry. Using geolocated plot-level data from all forestland transactions in France between 2014 and 2023 (over 100,000 plots) matched to forest age at sale (1–219 years), we empirically confirm that standard pooled Ricardian estimates are biased, typically understating the benefits of warmer climates to forestry – in our case, by nearly a factor of two. Consistent with our theory, age-structured coefficients exhibit an inverted U-shape with stand age: capitalization of climate productive effects into forestland prices first strengthens as stands mature and then weakens as slow-growing species increasingly dominate older age classes. Our findings hold under multiple sensitivity analyses and extensions, making clear that ignoring age-related dynamics systematically biases climate estimates in Ricardian applications to forestry.
abstract_zh: 本研究将李嘉图框架拓展至林业领域，通过纳入树木生长与采伐动态来实现。确实，在农业的标准李嘉图应用中，假定农田价格反映的是最适应气候作物所带来的永续年利润流，而林地价格则额外资本化了数十年间累积的立木年龄依赖价值。结合李嘉图与福斯特曼方法，我们从理论上证明，这种年龄依赖性系统地与树种（进而与气候）相关联，使得林分年龄成为标准混合李嘉图回归中的混淆因素。我们的理论提出了一种修正方法——年龄分层李嘉图方法——该方法在不同林分年龄等级间回归气候-价值关系，其中以最幼龄等级获得的系数最接近林业背景下真实李嘉图效应的近似值。利用2014年至2023年间法国所有林地交易的地理定位地块级数据（超过10万块地块），并将其与销售时的林龄（1至219年）相匹配，我们实证确认，标准混合李嘉图估计存在偏差，通常低估了较暖气候对林业的益处——在本案例中，低估幅度接近两倍。与我们的理论一致，年龄分层系数随林分年龄呈倒U型形态：气候生产效应向林地价格的资本化首先随林分成熟而增强，随后因生长缓慢的树种在较老龄等级中日益占优而减弱。我们的发现在多项敏感性分析和扩展检验中保持稳健，明确表明忽视年龄相关动态会系统性地使林业李嘉图应用中的气候估计产生偏差。
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: The impacts of global warming on forestry: an age-structured Ricardian approach
title_zh: 全球变暖对林业的影响：基于年龄结构的李嘉图方法

abstract: We experimentally investigate targeting decisions in a setting where a human player competes for influence in a network against a computerized opponent with opposing views, whose targeting choice is revealed before the player acts. By varying network structure, opponent influence, and nodes opinion heterogeneity, we find that players typically adopt best-response strategies based on relative influence. However, they sometimes deviate – for example, by erroneously targeting central nodes or by avoiding the opponent’s target. Targeting is also affected by affinity and opposition biases, the strength of which depends on the initial opinion distribution. Targeting the center, avoiding the competitor’s target, or selecting nodes based on their initial opinions when these are not best responses generates significant efficiency losses.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了一个情境下的目标选择决策，其中人类玩家与持有相反观点的计算机化对手在网络中争夺影响力，而对手的目标选择在玩家行动前已被揭示。通过改变网络结构、对手影响力及节点观点异质性，我们发现玩家通常基于相对影响力采取最佳响应策略。然而，他们有时会偏离这一策略——例如，错误地瞄准中心节点或避开对手的目标。目标选择还受到亲和性与对立偏见的影响，其强度取决于初始观点分布。当瞄准中心、避开竞争者目标或依据初始观点选择节点并非最佳响应时，这些行为会导致显著的效率损失。
title: Competing for influence in networks through strategic targeting
title_zh: 通过策略性目标选择在网络中竞争影响力

abstract: ABSTRACT Public lead texts from Swiss newspapers contain most of the signal needed to nowcast Swiss GDP growth in real time. I build an indicator from daily topic‐specific sentiment and recession measures extracted from three Swiss newspapers and evaluate it in pseudo‐real time. The indicator is competitive with established Swiss business‐cycle indicators and simple statistical benchmarks once enough within‐quarter news has arrived, and the gains remain after excluding COVID‐19 and the Global Financial Crisis. I then compare three design choices that arise in text‐based nowcasting systems: lead texts versus full articles, keyword‐based scoring versus large‐language‐model classification, and static versus dynamic factor aggregation. None delivers systematic forecast gains over the baseline; the LLM variant is more costly and harder to hold fixed in real time, and the full‐article indicators often perform worse. The main contribution is therefore a design result: in this public‐data setting, lead texts and simple methods already recover most of the useful nowcasting signal.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Nowcasting Swiss GDP Growth From Public Lead Texts: Simple Methods Are Sufficient
title_zh: 从公开领先文本预测瑞士GDP增长：简单方法足矣

abstract: This paper introduces a novel sign restriction identification within a structural Bayesian vector autoregression (VAR) to analyse how labour productivity responds to supply and demand shocks and to quantify the contribution of shocks to cyclical fluctuations. We apply our framework to the Italian labour market because it is characterised by several rigidities despite multiple labour reforms. Using data spanning 1984Q1–2023Q3, we show that the cyclical productivity‐output correlation has significantly declined since the late 1990s. Moreover, the relative volatility of employment to output has decreased, while that of hours per worker has increased. We estimate our specification on Italian data from 1996Q1 to 2023Q3 and disentangle three supply shocks from one demand shock. We find that automation and technology shocks generate persistent gains in productivity, while labour supply and aggregate demand shocks lower it persistently. The negative effect of demand shocks is due to the COVID‐19 pandemic. Labour supply, automation, and technology shocks are the dominant drivers of productivity both at short and long horizons. Labour supply shocks explain most of the productivity slowdown during the double‐dip recession, while all shocks contributed to its aftermath recovery during the period 2012–2019. We carry out a series of sensitivity analyses, which confirm our results.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: What Are The Drivers of Labour Productivity in Italy?
title_zh: 意大利劳动生产率的驱动因素是什么？

abstract: Recent debates regarding the relative efficiency of hybrid and pure platform modes have become central in platform economics. This paper investigates the effect of the platform mode in a setting where downstream sellers on the platform purchase products from an upstream manufacturer before competing in quantities. The choice between the hybrid and pure platform modes alters the upstream manufacturer's pricing incentives and, in turn, affects total market quantity and welfare. I derive the conditions under which the hybrid platform mode yields a higher, lower, or equal total quantity compared to the pure platform mode. The key determinant is the modularity of demand, which depends on the elasticity of marginal revenue. These results highlight that platform regulation should jointly consider demand structure, upstream pricing behavior, and market structure.
abstract_zh: 关于混合平台模式与纯平台模式相对效率的近期争论已成为平台经济学的核心议题。本文在平台上的下游卖家从上游制造商购买产品后进行数量竞争的背景下，考察了平台模式的影响。混合平台模式与纯平台模式的选择改变了上游制造商的定价激励，进而影响市场总产量与福利。我推导出混合平台模式相较于纯平台模式产生更高、更低或相等总产量的条件。关键决定因素为需求的可模块性，其取决于边际收益的弹性。这些结果强调，平台监管应综合考虑需求结构、上游定价行为及市场结构。
title: Hybrid Versus Pure Platforms Under Endogenous Wholesale Pricing
title_zh: 内生批发定价下混合平台与纯平台之比较

abstract: Developing countries have increased sanitation investment to reduce diarrheal diseases. However, the direct health benefits of latrine construction can be offset by water pollution externalities due to poor treatment of fecal sludge. I estimate these negative externalities of a sanitation policy in India that subsidized the construction of over 100 million latrines. Exploiting geographical variation in soil characteristics and the differential increase in latrine coverage across districts, I find that the policy increases river pollution by 72%. While it reduces diarrheal mortality overall, this positive health effect is two-thirds smaller in areas with lower capacities for treatment of fecal sludge where water pollution externalities are consequently larger.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家已增加卫生设施投资以减少腹泻疾病。然而，厕所建设带来的直接健康效益可能因粪便污泥处理不善所产生的水污染外部性而被抵消。我评估了印度一项补贴超过1亿个厕所建设的卫生政策所带来的这些负面外部性。利用土壤特征的地理差异及各地区厕所覆盖率的不同增长，我发现该政策使河流污染增加了72%。尽管总体上降低了腹泻死亡率，但在粪便污泥处理能力较低、水污染外部性相应较大的地区，这一正面健康效应减少了三分之二。
title: Unintended consequences of sanitation investment: Negative externalities on water quality and health in India
title_zh: 卫生投资的非预期后果：印度水质与健康的负外部性

abstract: We study the rationale behind firms’ investment in risky financial assets by formulating and estimating a dynamic model in which firms allocate their precautionary savings to both safe and risky securities. In equilibrium, risky financial asset holdings are positively related to the sensitivity of a firm’s financing deficit to the risky asset returns—the “financing deficit beta”. Using a comprehensive sample of US corporate financial asset holdings, we find evidence of a positive correlation between risky financial asset holdings and financing deficit betas that capture firms’ incentives to hedge interest-rate risk. Precautionary motives are stronger in small, high-volatility, and R&D-intensive firms.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建并估计一个动态模型来探讨企业投资于风险金融资产的动因，在该模型中，企业将预防性储蓄配置于安全与风险证券。均衡状态下，风险金融资产持有量与企业的融资缺口对风险资产收益的敏感性——即“融资缺口贝塔”——呈正相关。基于美国企业金融资产持有的全面样本，我们发现风险金融资产持有量与反映企业对冲利率风险激励的融资缺口贝塔之间存在正相关关系。预防性动机在小规模、高波动性及研发密集型企业中更为显著。
title: Bonding with risk: Corporate investment and savings in risky financial assets
title_zh: 风险共担：企业风险金融资产投资与储蓄

abstract: Theories are ambiguous about whether households of higher or lower wealth consistently trade against expected returns. I employ unique matched data on US household trades in the housing market and their wealth to study trade timings and quantify the implications for portfolio returns and wealth inequality. I find that poorer households consistently buy houses when expected returns are low (e.g., after price increases) and sell when expected returns are high (e.g., after price declines). The estimated dispersion in expected portfolio returns from active trades is large, with an interquartile range across the wealth distribution of 65 basis points per year. Back-of-envelope calculations suggest this return dispersion could account for roughly one-fifth of observed wealth concentration beyond what income differences alone explain, within the interquartile range.
abstract_zh: 关于家庭财富水平高低是否一贯地与预期收益反向交易，理论界尚无定论。我利用美国住房市场中家庭交易与其财富的独特匹配数据，研究交易时机，并量化其对投资组合收益及财富不平等的影响。研究发现，较贫困家庭在预期收益较低时（如房价上涨后）一贯购房，而在预期收益较高时（如房价下跌后）出售。主动交易导致的预期投资组合收益离散程度较大，财富分布的四分位距为每年65个基点。粗略估算表明，这一收益离散程度可能解释了在仅考虑收入差异之外，观察到的财富集中现象中约五分之一，且该效应位于四分位距范围内。
title: Who buys high and sells low: Trading against expected returns and wealth inequality
title_zh: 谁在高买低卖：逆预期收益交易与财富不平等
